description: A semantic card container for grouping related form fields with a title, description, and optional footer. Renders as a Card with no interactive behavior of its own.

focus.notes: FormSection itself is not focusable. Focus management is delegated to the form controls rendered inside the children and footer slots.

announcements: The section title is rendered as a heading and announced as part of the page structure
The description is announced as supplementary text

contrast.text: Meets WCAG AA (>4.5:1 for title and description text)
contrast.ui: Meets WCAG AA (>3:1 for card border and destructive accent)

consumerResponsibilities: Use proper heading hierarchy by considering the surrounding page structure
Associate all form labels with their corresponding inputs using htmlFor
When using the destructive variant, ensure the footer actions match the intent
